parameters.name: ethanol_opt_freq.py

entries.purpose: initial ethanol geometry for ORCA optimization

proposal.reason: Create the initial geometry with structure.prepare, write a pinned Python SDK script, then run one managed ORCA Opt+Freq calculation via python.execute using the prepared geometry as the required anchor. The script parses job.xyz and stdout.out into observations for all requested deliverable goals, retains returned files, and preserves explicit limitations.
